children.name: Reduce iterable into aggregated nested structure
children.description: Reduce an iterable into a nested Map or array by applying an aggregation function to grouped values. Combines grouping with reduction in a single operation, producing summary statistics or aggregate measures per group.
children.applicable_when: Reduce an iterable into a nested Map or array by applying an aggregation function to grouped values. Combines grouping with reduction in a single operation, producing summary statistics or aggregate measures per group.
selector_terms: Input is an iterable (array, set, or other iterable collection)
You need to group data by one or more keys
You need to apply a reducer function (sum, count, mean, custom aggregation) to each group
Output should be a nested structure (Map or array) with one aggregated value per group
Reduce iterable into aggregated nested structure
